title: Lead Data Engineer - (NPW)
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------



Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  

  

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------


**Job Summary**
---------------


We are seeking an experienced **Data Migration Lead** to drive end\-to\-end data migration initiatives across enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in data migration strategies, ETL development, data transformation, data quality management, and Python scripting. Experience migrating data from legacy or third\-party platforms into **Salesforce** is highly desirable.


The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, developers, and QA teams to ensure successful planning, execution, validation, and deployment of data migration activities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead and manage end\-to\-end data migration projects, including planning, design, execution, validation, and post\-deployment support.
* Analyze source system data structures and map data to target applications.
* Design, build, and optimize ETL pipelines for large\-scale data extraction, transformation, and loading.
* Develop reusable migration frameworks, scripts, and automation utilities.
* Create and maintain data mapping documents, migration runbooks, and reconciliation reports.
* Perform data profiling, cleansing, standardization, and validation activities.
* Collaborate with business and technical teams to define migration requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, completeness, and compliance throughout migration cycles.
* Troubleshoot migration issues and implement corrective actions.
* Lead mock migrations, cutover planning, and production deployments.
* Mentor junior team members and establish migration best practices.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
-------------------------------------

* 6 to 7 years of hands\-on experience in **Data Migration**, Data Integration, or ETL Development.
* Strong experience designing and implementing ETL pipelines.
* Proficiency in **Python scripting** for data extraction, transformation, validation, and automation.
* Hands\-on experience with SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
* Experience in data mapping, data profiling, reconciliation, and migration testing.
* Knowledge of data quality and data governance best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience migrating data from legacy systems, ERP, CRM, or custom platforms into **Salesforce**.
* Familiarity with Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API, Data Import Wizard, or related Salesforce migration tools.
* Experience with cloud\-based integration platforms and ETL tools such as Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or similar.
* Knowledge of Salesforce data model and CRM business processes.
* Experience with data warehousing and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Salesforce certifications or relevant integration certifications.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* Experience leading migration workstreams in complex enterprise transformation programs.
* Ability to manage multiple migration cycles and coordinate cross\-functional teams.

**Compensation**
----------------



Estimated Pay Range:  

  

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion**
--------------------------------------------



*At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.*

title: Associate Lead Quality Engineer
description:
**Introduction**  


Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.
  

**Overview** **Job Description: Associate Lead, Quality Engineering**

**Position Title:** **Associate Quality Engineering Lead**
  

**Department:** Software Quality Assurance  

**Location:** *India*  

**Reports To:** QA Leader

 **About Arthur J. Gallagher**


Arthur J. Gallagher is one of the world’s largest insurance brokerage and risk management companies, providing tailored insurance solutions and strategic organizational wellbeing initiatives. With over 50,000 employees globally, Gallagher is committed to innovation, client success, and delivering high‑quality solutions across all aspects of the business.

 **Position Summary**


We are seeking an experienced Associate Quality Engineering Lead who will act as a validation and quality assurance expert and review the functionality of existing systems. You will conduct requirement analysis, define test strategy \& design and lead execution to guarantee superior outcomes. The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership across QA initiatives, work across the full product lifecycle, partnering closely with engineering, product, and design to define test strategies, build automated testing frameworks, and proactively identify issues before they reach production.


Self\-motivated in handling multiple assignments across cross\-functional teams.

  

  

**How you'll make an impact** **Responsibilities:*** **Leadership \& Strategy**


	+ Lead and mentor the QA team in defining and executing comprehensive QA strategies, test plans, and test cases.
	+ Drive adoption of automated testing tools and frameworks to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and reliability.
	+ Introduce and scale AI\-driven QA capabilities, including intelligent test case generation, prioritization, and insights.
	+ Define and establish QA metrics and KPIs to measure testing effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
	+ Oversee defect triage, root cause analysis, and quality risk assessments across releases.
	+ Stay current with industry trends in test automation, AI\-assisted testing, and quality engineering practices. **Planning \& Execution Test**


	+ Review product requirements, specifications, and user stories; translate them into detailed test plans and comprehensive test suites.
	+ Define and execute test strategies for new and existing features, including:
	+ Functional testing
	+ End to End \& Regression testing
	+ Security testing (wherever applicable)
	+ Exploratory and random testing
	+ Ensure full verification and validation of the software stack through both manual and automated testing
	+ Investigate and troubleshoot issues reported by customers or internal stakeholders, driving root cause resolution. **Automation \& Tools**


	+ Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated test frameworks.
	+ Collaborate with development teams to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
	+ Ensure scalable and maintainable automation solutions aligned with product architecture. **Defect Management**


	+ Own defect submission, tracking, validation, and closure throughout the SDLC.
	+ Partner closely with engineering and product teams to ensure timely resolution of quality issues.
	+ Monitor defect trends and implement preventive quality improvements. **Cross**‑**Functional Collaboration**


	+ Partner closely with product owners and software engineers to align quality standards and priorities.
	+ Participate in release planning and deployment activities, ensuring smooth and successful releases.
	+ Ensure QA alignment with business goals, user expectations, and technical requirements. **Technical Quality Engineering**


	+ Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
	+ Apply technical troubleshooting and risk\-based testing approaches across complex systems. **Project \& Delivery Support**


	+ Support Agile ceremonies and coordinate test planning, execution, and reporting.
	+ Collaborate with product owners and SMEs for requirement analysis and data mapping clarifications.
	+ Ensure timely QA deliverables aligned with sprint goals and release timelines.


  

**About you** **Qualifications:*** + **Education**
	+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
	+ **Experience**
	+ 6\+ years of overall experience in Software Quality Engineering
	+ Strong experience leading both manual and automated testing in Agile environments
	+ Experience supporting CI/CD\-driven deployments
	+ Strong understanding of insurance domain—policy, commissions, premiums, claims, billing etc. **Technical Skills**


	+ Strong experience testing complex, highly integrated enterprise systems, including cloud, distributed, and legacy platforms
	+ Hands on experience with automated and testing tools Selenium, AccelQ, Cypress, Postman\-API, AppDynamics etc. or similar tools
	+ Understanding of prompt engineering principles applied to test generation and validation
	+ Familiarity with AI agent frameworks applied to testing workflows
	+ Familiarity with cloud data warehouse platforms (Snowflake, Azure Synapse, BigQuery)
	+ Strong technical troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills **Soft Skills**


	+ Strong leadership abilities and a collaborative mindset.
	+ Excellent problem‑solving and analytical skills.
	+ Clear and effective written and verbal communication
	+ Ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams


  

**Additional Information**  

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Internal IT Admin
description:
VIPoint Solutions is looking for an Internal System Administrator to manage the day\-to\-day technology environment that keeps our team productive. The role covers IT asset management, end\-user support, network administration, and network and endpoint security administration, with strong hands\-on Ubuntu Linux expertise and involvement in the planned macOS transition.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Maintain a complete and accurate inventory of all electronic and IT assets.
  
Own the full asset lifecycle including procurement coordination, tagging, allocation, transfer, repair/RMA, and retirement or disposal.
  
Handle asset issue and return during employee onboarding and exit, including data wipe, re\-imaging, and sign\-off documentation.
  
Provide first and second\-line support for hardware and software issues.
  
Troubleshoot Ubuntu Linux, Windows, and macOS systems, business applications, VPN clients, printers, and audio/video conferencing setups.
  
Build and maintain standard OS images and provisioning workflows.
  
Support the planned macOS migration including device evaluation, pilot rollout, application compatibility mapping, data migration, and user training.
  
Manage the internal IT helpdesk queue and ensure tickets are resolved within agreed response times.
  
Administer and monitor the office LAN and WAN, including switches, access points, and ISP links.
  
Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot routers, managed switches, Wi\-Fi access points, and VLAN segmentation.
  
Administer the Sophos firewall, including firewall rules, web and application filtering, VPN tunnels, IPS policies, and firmware updates.
  
Support internal server and infrastructure administration, including backup jobs, restore testing, and file/print services.
  
Manage patching, endpoint antivirus/EDR, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint hardening.
  
Maintain IT, network, security, and asset documentation.
  
Work closely with HR, Finance, vendors, and compliance teams on IT\-related requirements.
  
Requirements
  
Strong hands\-on Ubuntu Linux desktop administration and troubleshooting.
  
Working knowledge of Windows desktop administration and troubleshooting.
  
Exposure to macOS administration or willingness and aptitude to build it quickly.
  
Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, subnetting, VLANs, routing, NAT, VPN, and Wi\-Fi.
  
Practical experience configuring and troubleshooting routers, managed switches, and firewalls.
  
Experience with patch management, antivirus/endpoint protection tools, and vulnerability remediation.
  
Experience managing IT asset inventories and physical audits.
  
Familiarity with helpdesk/ticketing systems and structured incident handling.
  
Excellent spoken and written English.
  
Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
  
Ability to work independently, prioritise competing requests, and follow issues through to closure.
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
Hands\-on experience with Sophos firewall / Sophos Central administration.
  
Experience working in an SEZ / Infopark unit and familiarity with asset movement documentation.
  
Exposure to Active Directory / LDAP, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365 administration.
  
Scripting ability using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  
Experience with RMM, MDM, or endpoint management tools.
  
Experience planning or executing a cross\-platform endpoint migration.
  
Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A\+, Network\+, Security\+, CCNA, MCSA/MCSE, RHCSA, or Sophos Certified Engineer.
  
Basic understanding of ISO 27001 controls or similar security frameworks.
  
Why Join Us?
  
  

Work with a stable, growing IT services organisation with a global client base.
  
Join a Great Place to Work certified organisation.
  
Work from a modern SEZ campus facility at Infopark, Kakkanad.
  
Gain exposure to enterprise\-grade infrastructure and security practices.
  
Get hands\-on experience with modern endpoint, network, and security technologies.
  
Take ownership of a well\-defined domain with room to shape processes from the ground up.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
**Role Purpose** :  



  

As a Lead Data Engineer at Prevalent AI, you will lead the design and delivery of advanced data engineering projects for our clients. You will write code, review the team's code, and stay accountable for how the solution performs in production.


The work involves large data volumes, complex joins and transformations, and tight processing windows. Clients usually come to us when their pipelines are slow, expensive or difficult to change. Working out why, and then fixing it, is a large part of the role.


This role suits engineers who know Spark internals well enough to read the logs and explain what is going wrong, who ask the right questions about the data before they write code, and who can run a small team to a delivery date.  



  

**Key Accountabilities** :


* Lead the design and delivery of client data engineering projects, from understanding the requirement through to production.
* Design pipelines that meet their SLA and continue to do so as data volumes grow.
* Diagnose failures and performance problems in large distributed jobs using logs and metrics.
* Set the data layout and storage strategy so jobs read only the data they need.
* Build reusable, configuration\-driven components that cut development effort across the team.
* Review the team's code and agree the standards the team works to.
* Work with client teams to pin down the requirement and understand the data before development starts.
* Contribute to the platform work around delivery, including object storage, containerisation and CI/CD.

Mentor developers, and document design decisions, tuning approaches and operational runbooks.  

* 

**Skills \& Experience** :  



  

**Must Have** :  



  

* **10\+ years in data engineering, with at least 5 years hands\-on PySpark on large\-volume workloads, and still writing code daily.**
* Deep understanding of Spark internals: execution model, stages and tasks, shuffle, partitioning, broadcast versus sort\-merge joins, adaptive query execution, and memory and spill behaviour.
* Experience tuning long\-running jobs down to an SLA and handling data skew, with specific examples of how a job was diagnosed and what changed.
* Hands\-on experience with time\-series data at scale: event\-time semantics, sliding and tumbling windows, and as\-of or point\-in\-time joins across billions of rows.
* Strong Delta Lake or Iceberg experience, covering partitioning, compaction, sort keys, data pruning and versioning.
* Able to read Spark logs, the Spark UI and the history server and work out why a job is slow or failing.
* Experience running Spark on self\-managed clusters, not only on managed platforms.
* Strong Python, with experience building reusable, configuration\-driven frameworks rather than one\-off scripts.

Able to lead a small team through code reviews, mentoring and unblocking, and hold a delivery date.  

* 

**Good to Have**

* Trade surveillance, capital markets or FX experience, and familiarity with trade, order and market data.
* KDB/q exposure, or experience migrating off a vendor surveillance platform.
* Experience moving Spark workloads to object storage such as MinIO or S3, and running Spark on Kubernetes.
* CI/CD, automated testing and observability for data pipelines.
* Exposure to regulatory or compliance\-driven delivery in a banking environment.

title: Security Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

The Security Architect is a cross\-domain cybersecurity authority responsible for designing and positioning end\-to\-end security architectures spanning Network Security, End User Computing (EUC) Security, and Data Centre Security. The role serves both ISP clients (managing telco\-grade security infrastructure) and MSI customers (enterprise security transformation). A strong commercial mindset and pre\-sales ability are essential to position security as a value driver rather than a cost centre.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Architect holistic security solutions covering perimeter, internal segmentation, endpoint, cloud, and identity layers
* Design network security solutions: NGFW, IPS/IDS, SD\-WAN security overlays, DDoS protection, and carrier\-grade NAT/CGN security
* Architect End User Computing security — endpoint protection platforms (EPP), EDR/XDR, VDI security, email security, and web proxy/filtering
* Design Data Centre security: micro\-segmentation, East\-West firewall controls, WAF, privileged access management (PAM), and Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA)
* Position and architect SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) and SSE solutions — Zscaler, Prisma Access, Cato Networks

title: Network Architect
description:
**◆ Role Overview**

The Network Architect is the most versatile technical authority in the Solution Engineering team, covering the full spectrum of IP networking from ISP backbone design to enterprise SD\-WAN, NFV, SASE, and GPON/FTTH access deployments. This role is critical to the MSI business where integrated network solutions are central to large deal pursuits. The architect must combine CCIE\-level depth with the commercial acumen to shape multi\-vendor network proposals for carrier, enterprise, and government customers.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Architect carrier\-grade IP/MPLS backbone, metro Ethernet, and Service Provider edge networks
* Design enterprise campus and branch networks: Routing (BGP, OSPF, IS\-IS), Switching (RSTP, EVPN\-VXLAN), and network automation
* Architect SD\-WAN solutions — Cisco Catalyst SD\-WAN (Viptela), VMware VeloCloud, Fortinet SD\-WAN, and Nokia Nuage for large enterprise and ISP overlay deployment
* Design NFV/SDN architectures using OpenStack, ONAP, Kubernetes CNFs, and virtual CPE (vCPE) platforms

title: Fiber Optics Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

The Fiber Optics Architect is the domain expert for all physical\-layer optical infrastructure design — from Outside Plant (OSP) cable route design and FTTH access network planning to high\-capacity DWDM/OTN transport architecture. This role is pivotal to the MSI business where fiber infrastructure underpins every managed service and connectivity deal. The architect must bridge field\-level technical depth with the ability to produce bankable, customer\-ready designs and cost models.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Design Outside Plant (OSP) fiber networks: aerial, underground, duct\-based, and submarine — route surveys, cable sizing, and splicing plans
* Architect FTTH/FTTB/FTTC/FTTx networks — PON architecture (GPON/XGS\-PON), ODF planning, distribution point units (DPU), and ONT selection
* Design high\-capacity DWDM and OTN transport networks for metro and long\-haul using Ciena, Nokia 1830, or Fujitsu platforms
* Produce fiber route maps, splice diagrams, loss budgets, and optical power budgets for acceptance testing
* Develop BoQ for civil works, cable, equipment, and integration costs — critical for MSI project bids
* Conduct OTDR interpretation, power meter testing, and light source characterisation — both in design review and site acceptance
* Advise on dark fibre IRU/lease strategies for ISP backbone buildouts
* Support pre\-sales: technical presentations on fiber solution value, coverage maps, rollout timelines, and ROI models
* Coordinate with civil/structural engineering teams on duct sizing, joint chambers, and data centre entry requirements

title: IoT Architect
description:
**◆ Role Overview**

The IoT Architect is a broad\-spectrum technology strategist who can design end\-to\-end IoT solutions from the device/sensor layer through connectivity, edge processing, cloud platforms, and application layers. As the ISP transitions to an MSI model, IoT is a key growth vertical — spanning smart cities, industrial automation, smart metering, fleet management, healthcare IoT, and building management systems. The ideal candidate has a wide aperture across networking, cloud, data, and security, and can position IoT solutions confidently in commercial discussions.

**◆ Key Responsibilities**

* Design end\-to\-end IoT architectures: device layer, connectivity (LPWAN / NB\-IoT / LTE\-M / 5G / Wi\-Fi 6 / LoRaWAN / Zigbee), edge, and cloud platform
* Architect IoT platforms: AWS IoT Core / Greengrass, Azure IoT Hub / IoT Central, Google Cloud IoT Core, ThingsBoard, or Bosch IoT Suite
* Design edge computing architectures: AWS Outposts / Local Zones, Azure IoT Edge, NVIDIA Jetson platforms for real\-time inference
* Develop smart city solution architectures: smart metering, smart lighting, traffic management, waste management, and environmental monitoring
* Architect industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions for manufacturing, oil \& gas, utilities, and smart buildings — integrating OT/IT convergence via ISA\-95/IEC 62443
* Design IoT security frameworks: device identity management (PKI/X.509\), TLS/DTLS transport security, OTA update management, and network segmentation
* Position IoT connectivity services leveraging ISP assets (NB\-IoT, LTE\-M network, eSIM, APN management)
* Support MSI bids: technical solution writing, BoQ for gateways, sensors, platform licences, and integration services
* Maintain broad OEM awareness: Cisco IoT, Sierra Wireless, Telit, Advantech, Cradlepoint, and platform vendors
* Conduct market sensing — staying current on emerging IoT standards (Matter, Thread, Wi\-Fi HaLow, 5G URLLC for IIoT)

**◆ Technical Expertise — Broad Knowledge Requirements**

**The IoT Architect role requires broad technology coverage rather than a single deep\-stack specialism:**

* Connectivity layer: NB\-IoT, LTE\-M, LoRaWAN, Sigfox, Zigbee, Z\-Wave, Thread, Wi\-Fi 6/6E, Bluetooth LE — protocol trade\-offs and application mapping
* Edge platforms: AWS IoT Greengrass, Azure IoT Edge, Balena.io, or equivalent — deployment, container orchestration at edge
* Cloud IoT platforms: device registry, message brokering (MQTT/AMQP/HTTP), time\-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, Azure ADX)
* Data analytics: stream processing (Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Azure Event Hubs), batch analytics, and BI dashboarding (Grafana, Power BI, Tableau)
* AI/ML at edge: TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, or NVIDIA Triton inference — awareness of on\-device ML for anomaly detection
* Security: PKI for device identity, FIPS 140\-2, CVE awareness for embedded systems, IEC 62443 for ICS/SCADA environments
* Protocols: MQTT, CoAP, AMQP, LwM2M, OPC\-UA — strengths and appropriate use cases
